title: Hexsweeper 3D: Amber Codex
tagline: A hex-tile minesweeper on a Goldberg sphere, illuminated like a scholar's annotated globe.
aesthetic: The board reads like a cabinet-of-curiosities artifact: warm amber resin tiles float over deep slate, each face catching light as though hand-lacquered. Cleared cells reveal aged parchment tones with letterpress-weight numerals in a serif cut. The sphere rotates with the unhurried confidence of an orrery, not a game widget.
mechanicTwist: When a flood-fill clears a region, each newly revealed cell lights up in a brief amber pulse radiating outward from the origin dig — purely cosmetic.
helpLede: Dig to reveal a hex face; flag to mark a suspected mine. Flood-fill clears contiguous safe regions automatically.
hudNote: Every safe cell is a folio turned.
